subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should Control UI theming stay with Claw/Knot/Dash plus one browser-local tweakcn import slot, or should OpenClaw sponsor a built-in preset gallery and custom theme studio with a broader persistence contract?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally expose a narrower one-slot tweakcn import model, while this issue asks for a larger in-product authoring and persistence surface that needs product/design ownership before implementation.

options.title: Define a narrow built-in theming roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

options.title: Keep tweakcn-only in core
options.body: Document that the existing import slot is the supported customization path and narrow or close the larger studio request after preserving the external editor alternative.

options.title: Split staged theme work
options.body: Track interactive preview, gateway-backed persistence, accessibility presets, and local override editing as separate product-approved slices.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow built-in theming roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned on the live issue and has the strongest current history on the Control UI theming path.
